about: How the soundtrack's slots (pieces.json) become the new world's music records (tools/ArgoniaPlugin/NewWorldMusic.cs; docs/design/music.md 'In game'). Each region plays its atmosphere class's exploration type (the class from newworld/sources/atmosphere/regions.json); its day pieces play 06:00-20:00 and the night pieces 20:00-06:00, as Skyrim's explore tracks are conditioned on GetCurrentTime. Combat, death, level-up and discovery are Skyrim's default music types: the battle pieces and stings are added to them for the new world only, and Skyrim's own tracks in them are kept out of the new world.
